video_title: Candace Parker Gets Real with Stewie & Myles

quotes.speaker: Candace Parker
quotes.summary_phrase: Candace Parker on the difficulty of roster construction for Team USA
quotes.excerpt: If you are going to advocate to take somebody or put somebody on the roster, you have to take somebody off.
quotes.quote: Here is my philosophy: If you are going to advocate to take somebody or put somebody on the roster, you have to take somebody off. And that is the most difficult thing. You are also putting together a team, and as somebody that was cut in 2016 from the team, you understand the levels of what goes into picking the team. It is not always the 12 best players. It is the team that the committee or the coaches feel like can give them the most there.

quotes.speaker: Candace Parker
quotes.summary_phrase: Candace Parker on the growth of the WNBA and international talent
quotes.excerpt: France is the team that has really invested in their players. They're playing in the WNBA.
quotes.quote: I still believe that USA could win gold, silver, and bronze. We could stack three teams and probably win gold, silver, and bronze. And now France, some of these other teams that are coming along, you almost have to be really deliberate with how you put it together. France is the team that has really invested in their players. They're playing in the WNBA, and we're almost giving them a platform to know and learn our games. It is a challenge.

quotes.speaker: Breanna Stewart
quotes.summary_phrase: Breanna Stewart asks Candace Parker about potential sleepers for the World Cup
quotes.excerpt: Who are your sleepers for the World Cup?
quotes.quote: I was going to ask, who are your sleepers for the World Cup? I mean, I don't think anybody's a sleeper, but for the people that maybe don't pay attention as much, who's going to be good?

quotes.speaker: Candace Parker
quotes.summary_phrase: Candace Parker highlights the French national team's strength and WNBA investment
quotes.excerpt: France is the team that has really invested in their players. They're playing in the WNBA.
quotes.quote: You got your French connection on your team that are really good. You talk about Gabby Williams and the season that she's having, Marine Johannes playing well. Aste Ndour is French, right? France is the team that has really invested in their players. They're playing in the WNBA, and we're almost giving them a platform to know and learn our games.

quotes.summary_phrase: Candace Parker on the biggest changes in the WNBA since 2008

quotes.speaker: Candace Parker
quotes.summary_phrase: Candace Parker on the necessary mindset shift for players over 30
quotes.excerpt: It's about working smarter, not necessarily harder.
quotes.quote: There is a mindset change you have to have when you hit 30. I would say 32 was when I figured out there is a difference in the way. And I think you have to really lean into not necessarily it's about working smarter, not necessarily harder. And I say that in like, it's about quality, not quantity at this point when you get older. That goes into your pregame routine, it goes into your recovery, your activation, and things like that.

quotes.speaker: Candace Parker
quotes.summary_phrase: Candace Parker on the WNBA's need for more on-court debate and analysis
quotes.excerpt: Where the WNBA needs to go is more about debate on court and about skill set.
quotes.quote: Where the WNBA needs to go is more about debate on court and about skill set in basketball and all of that, and less about everything else. And so I hope to be able to bring that to the game.

quotes.speaker: Candace Parker
quotes.summary_phrase: Candace Parker on the importance of understanding WNBA history
quotes.excerpt: I think it's important that before you can and ball into something, you got to know the history.
quotes.quote: I think it's important that before you can and ball into something, you got to know the history and you got to take pride in learning that. I know all of us are students of the game, and I know there was a lot of basketball that probably happened before we existed, but it doesn't mean that we didn't ever stop to think about the people that kind of paved the way. I never watched Bill Russell play, I'll be honest, but I know his contributions to basketball. I know Abdul-Jabbar, I know his contributions. I know Sheryl Swoopes, same thing. So I feel like as a fan, if you're going to critique it, you're going to love it, you're going to dive into it, you got to understand where the game came from.

quotes.speaker: Candace Parker
quotes.summary_phrase: Candace Parker on the challenges of the WNBA's new schedule
quotes.excerpt: I think the teams that actually have the most players on World Cup are going to struggle.
quotes.quote: It's going to be interesting because I think the teams that actually have the most players on World Cup are going to struggle. Because there has never been a team that has had I think two or three players. During the Minnesota Dynasty, they never won the year that they had World Cup or Olympic breaks. Same thing with Vegas in 2024. They played really well and then they went into the Olympics, and you know, it's hard because you don't know whether to rest, rust, like all these things. And so I think it's going to be a unique situation for everyone.
